purpose: Side-by-side evidence for the architectures that were trained or trialled, grouped by task.
rules: Rows are comparable only inside one task. Tasks use different data, labels and metrics; never rank across tasks.
Inside a task, rows can still differ in input size, training length, threshold choice and how a metric is aggregated; see each row.
All values are development evidence (validation unless marked). None is an independent or clinical validation.
A model is marked Selected only when it is the one connected to the application. Rejected and Not integrated rows are kept visible on purpose.
